title: School to municipality, resolved by point in polygon
description: Which town each school building stands in, resolved from AOE-published coordinates against Census county subdivisions. Committed derived output: it has no source URL, so it carries a `kind: derived` provenance record naming the algorithm, its version, the pinned inputs and the run. Deliberately NOT derived from the AOE MailingCity, which is a postal designation -- Vermont post office names routinely cover parts of several towns, and the sparse screen tests the town the building stands in.

geoid.description: The county subdivision the coordinates fall in. Null when the geocoder returned none. Note it is not constrained to Vermont: schools near the border legitimately resolve to a New Hampshire subdivision, and forcing state 50 here would silently relocate them.

municipality.description: Null when the GEOID has no registry town. That is a join to resolve once, in the census import, rather than twice in two places that could disagree.

note.description: Required to be present, and null only where the resolution succeeded cleanly. An unexplained null municipality would be indistinguishable from one nobody looked at.

schools_without_coordinates.description: Schools AOE publishes no location for. Listed rather than omitted: a school missing from this file entirely could not be told apart from one nobody ran.
